name: Dataset hierarchy for complementary regional memory
status: Prospective dataset plan; no dataset download or efficacy run started by this amendment

primary.primary_endpoint: Equal-sequence mean present-frame Dice under full propagation
primary.role: Main medical-video development and evaluation dataset
primary.scope: Exploratory: repeatedly used during development; train/evaluation separation still required; patient independence unverified

secondary.primary_endpoint: Official J&F; report official aggregation and equal-video paired contrasts separately
secondary.supplementary: Dice for continuity with PolypGen; not a substitute for official J&F
secondary.scope: Exploratory transfer: earlier candidates were already evaluated on this split
secondary.availability: Existing project dataset; active-reader dataset gate still required

secondary.primary_endpoint: Official evaluator region similarity J and contour accuracy F; J&F summary where provided by pinned toolkit
supplementary: Official long-term stability metric where implemented
secondary.role: Long-term multi-object transfer; distractors, absence and reappearance
secondary.annotation_setup: Persistent object IDs in indexed PNG masks; initialization and scored frames follow pinned official metadata/toolkit, including differing object start frames
secondary.access: Official public download links; no author application described. Archive download and integrity have not yet been verified locally.
secondary.terms: Official repository: non-commercial research data; annotations CC BY 4.0; evaluator BSD-3-Clause
secondary.scope: Potential fresh transfer evaluation; audit prior local results and training exposure before calling it untouched
secondary.availability: Not downloaded or integrated. Official Drive metadata reverified 2026-11-12: valid.zip, 11,833,302,254 bytes. Raw download, archive contents/checksum and evaluation readiness remain unverified.

evaluation_rules: Complete PolypGen diagnostic and freeze one model/training configuration before secondary outcomes are examined.
Evaluate the frozen PolypGen-trained reader on secondary datasets without benchmark-specific tuning for the primary transfer analysis.
Any additional dataset-specific adapter training is a separate supervised experiment, with the same training allowance for the generic control.
Keep native SAM2, parameter/training-matched generic and regional arms under identical checkpoint, prompts, image geometry, native frame schedule and evaluation settings.
Use native object pointers and per-object banks; initialize instances only at official permitted prompt frames; no future GT enters inference.

Pin official evaluators and verify native replay, instance registration order, late object introduction, disappearing/reappearing objects, indexed-ID preservation and complete frame coverage before evaluation.
Keep per-dataset metrics and uncertainty separate; no pooled medical/natural-scene Dice average.
Secondary success cannot establish a PolypGen Dice gain when the primary comparison fails.
Published results are contextual comparisons unless checkpoint, training data, prompts, resolution, split and evaluation protocol match; local paired controls remain necessary.
Outputs, archives and tracker files are saved only in the configured Drive output tree.

not_selected.SA-V: Unavailable: user has no approved download links; no access workaround.
not_selected.MOSE_validation: Official repository states only first-frame validation annotations are distributed; server-based scoring is less suitable for the requested local full-trajectory diagnosis.
not_selected.LVOS_v2_test: Subsequent test annotations withheld; use public validation for reproducible local analysis.
